accepted.s: The e-Shram portal was launched in August 2021 by which Ministry?
o: Ministry of Rural Development
Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
Ministry of Labour and Employment
Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship
accepted.x: The e-Shram portal was launched in August 2021 by the Ministry of Labour and Employment.
accepted.tq: Identify the implementing ministry associated with the scheme.
accepted.sec: e-Shram portal - launch, age, UAN, registrations, AP data

accepted.s:
With reference to the e-Shram portal, consider the following statements:
1. It is India's first Aadhaar-seeded National Database of Unorganised Workers.
2. It provides every registered worker with a 12-digit Universal Account Number.
3. It is meant exclusively for organised-sector workers covered by EPFO and ESIC.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
o: 1 and 2 only
1 and 3 only
2 and 3 only
1, 2 and 3
accepted.x: Statements 1 and 2 are correct. Statement 3 is false because e-Shram is intended for eligible unorganised workers who are not members of EPFO or ESIC.
accepted.tq: Reject the statement that reverses the target group of the portal.
accepted.sec: e-Shram portal - launch, age, UAN, registrations, AP data

accepted.s: Which one of the following persons is eligible for registration on the e-Shram portal?
o: A 15-year-old unorganised worker who is not an income-tax payer
A 25-year-old unorganised worker who is an income-tax payer
A 40-year-old unorganised worker who is not an income-tax payer and is not covered by EPFO or ESIC
A 62-year-old unorganised worker who is not covered by any social-security scheme
accepted.x: Eligibility covers unorganised workers aged 16 to 59 who are not income-tax payers and are not members of EPFO or ESIC.
accepted.tq: Apply all eligibility conditions together rather than relying on age alone.
accepted.sec: e-Shram portal - launch, age, UAN, registrations, AP data

accepted.s: The Universal Account Number allotted through e-Shram is intended primarily to ensure that:
o: the worker becomes eligible for a minimum wage in every State
benefits can move with the worker anywhere in India
the worker is automatically enrolled in EPFO
the worker receives a permanent government job
accepted.x: The 12-digit UAN enables portability of benefits for the worker anywhere in India.
accepted.tq: Match the unique identifier with its precise portability function.
accepted.sec: e-Shram portal - launch, age, UAN, registrations, AP data

accepted.s: The e-Shram One-Stop Solution introduced in 2024 links how many central schemes?
accepted.x: The e-Shram One-Stop Solution links 15 central schemes, including PM-SVANidhi, PMSBY, PMJJBY, AB-PMJAY and PM-SYM.
accepted.tq: Recall the exact scheme-linkage figure from the quantitative detail.
accepted.sec: e-Shram portal - launch, age, UAN, registrations, AP data

accepted.s: As of July 2026, registrations on the e-Shram portal had crossed approximately:
o: 11.78 crore
21.78 crore
31.78 crore
41.78 crore
accepted.x: The number of e-Shram registrations was reported to be over 31.78 crore as of July 2026.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the reported crore figure from nearby numerical distractors.
accepted.sec: e-Shram portal - launch, age, UAN, registrations, AP data

accepted.s: The Inter-State Migrant Workmen (RECS) Act, 1979 has been subsumed in the:
o: Code on Wages, 2019
Industrial Relations Code, 2020
Code on Social Security, 2020
Occupational Safety, Health and Working Conditions Code, 2020
accepted.x: The Inter-State Migrant Workmen (RECS) Act, 1979 is now subsumed in the Occupational Safety, Health and Working Conditions Code, 2020.
accepted.tq: Discriminate between the four labour codes by matching the subject matter.
accepted.sec: Inter-State Migrant Workmen Act 1979 - code, registration, displacement allowance, ONORC

accepted.s: Under the Inter-State Migrant Workmen (RECS) Act, 1979, registration of an establishment was required when it employed:
o: 5 or more inter-State migrant workers
10 or more inter-State migrant workers
3 or more inter-State migrant workers
20 or more inter-State migrant workers
accepted.x: Establishments employing five or more inter-State migrant workers were required to register under the 1979 Act.
accepted.tq: Recall the statutory threshold and avoid substituting a common labour-law threshold.
accepted.sec: Inter-State Migrant Workmen Act 1979 - code, registration, displacement allowance, ONORC

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding inter-State migrant workers under the 1979 law:
1. Contractors were required to obtain licences.
2. Workers were entitled to a displacement allowance equal to 50 per cent of monthly wages.
3. Workers were entitled to a journey allowance.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
o: 1 and 2 only
1 and 3 only
2 and 3 only
1, 2 and 3
accepted.x: All three statements are correct: contractors required licences, and migrant workers were entitled to displacement allowance and journey allowance. The displacement allowance was 50 per cent of monthly wages.
accepted.tq: Check each statutory protection separately before selecting the combined option.
accepted.sec: Inter-State Migrant Workmen Act 1979 - code, registration, displacement allowance, ONORC

accepted.s: Which of the following is NOT a feature mentioned in relation to migrant workers under the Occupational Safety, Health and Working Conditions Code, 2020?
o: Coverage of workers who migrate on their own
Portability of PDS and social security across States
Annual travel allowance
Abolition of all contractor licensing requirements
accepted.x: The OSH Code covers workers who migrate on their own, provides for annual travel allowance and supports portability of PDS and social security. Abolition of all contractor licensing requirements is not a stated feature.
accepted.tq: Find the option that goes beyond the stated provisions of the Code.
accepted.sec: Inter-State Migrant Workmen Act 1979 - code, registration, displacement allowance, ONORC

accepted.s: The One Nation One Ration Card system enables migrant workers to:
o: receive wages directly from the Central Government
draw NFSA rations anywhere in India
claim only State-funded food subsidies
transfer their domicile permanently to another State
accepted.x: ONORC provides portability under the National Food Security Act, enabling migrants to draw rations anywhere in India.
accepted.tq: Link the portability mechanism with the specific benefit made portable.
accepted.sec: Inter-State Migrant Workmen Act 1979 - code, registration, displacement allowance, ONORC

accepted.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched under the Code on Social Security, 2020?
o: Gig worker — work exclusively under a traditional employer-employee relationship
Platform worker — work through online platforms
Aggregator — worker registered only under EPFO
Gig worker — worker entitled automatically to government employment
accepted.x: A platform worker is one who works through online platforms. Gig work is performed outside a traditional employer-employee relationship, while aggregators are recognised entities under the Code.
accepted.tq: Separate the definitions of gig workers, platform workers and aggregators.
accepted.sec: Gig and platform workers - Social Security Code definitions, state laws

accepted.s:
With reference to the Code on Social Security, 2020, consider the following statements:
1. It is the first law to recognise aggregators, gig workers and platform workers.
2. Aggregators are required to contribute 1–2 per cent of annual turnover to a social-security fund.
3. Such contribution is capped at 5 per cent of the payments made to workers.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
o: 1 and 2 only
1 and 3 only
2 and 3 only
1, 2 and 3
accepted.x: All three statements are correct. The Code recognises the three categories, and aggregator contributions are 1–2 per cent of annual turnover subject to a cap of 5 per cent of payments to workers.
accepted.tq: Retain both the contribution rate and the separate statutory ceiling.
accepted.sec: Gig and platform workers - Social Security Code definitions, state laws

accepted.s: Which one of the following is correct regarding gig workers under the Social Security framework described?
o: They automatically acquire employee status upon registration.
They are guaranteed a minimum wage under the Code.
They can register from the age of 16, and National and State Social Security Boards are provided for.
They can register only after attaining 18 years of age.
accepted.x: Gig workers can register from the age of 16, and the framework provides for National and State Social Security Boards. It does not automatically confer employee status or guarantee a minimum wage.
accepted.tq: Use the positive provision and reject the overbroad employee-status claims.
accepted.sec: Gig and platform workers - Social Security Code definitions, state laws

accepted.s: Which of the following is NOT presently assured to gig workers under the limitations described?
o: Consideration under National and State Social Security Boards
Employee status in every case
Access to a social-security framework
Registration from the age of 16
accepted.x: Gig workers do not receive employee status as an automatic entitlement. The framework does provide for registration from age 16 and National and State Social Security Boards.
accepted.tq: Identify the option that converts a limited social-security recognition into full employee status.
accepted.sec: Gig and platform workers - Social Security Code definitions, state laws

accepted.s: Which of the following State-level measures is correctly matched?
o: Rajasthan — Platform-Based Gig Workers (Registration and Welfare) Act, 2023, with a welfare board funded by a transaction cess
Karnataka — enacted a 2023 national gig-workers law
Telangana — established the Central Social Security Board through a State Act
Rajasthan — abolished registration requirements for platform workers
accepted.x: Rajasthan enacted the Platform-Based Gig Workers (Registration and Welfare) Act, 2023, creating a welfare board funded by a cess on transactions. Karnataka's 2024 measure and Telangana's measure were described as proposed laws.
accepted.tq: Distinguish an enacted State law from proposed measures in other States.
accepted.sec: Gig and platform workers - Social Security Code definitions, state laws

accepted.s:
According to the NITI Aayog estimate, the number of gig and platform workers was projected as follows:
1. 77 lakh in 2020–21
2. 1.27 crore in 2024–25
3. 1.43 crore in 2025–26
Which of the statements given above are correct?
o: 1 and 2 only
1 and 3 only
2 and 3 only
1, 2 and 3
accepted.x: The NITI Aayog 2022 report gave the sequence of 77 lakh in 2020–21, 1.27 crore in 2024–25 and 1.43 crore in 2025–26.
accepted.tq: Verify each figure in the time series rather than relying only on its upward trend.
accepted.sec: Gig and platform workers - Social Security Code definitions, state laws

accepted.s: Which one of the following correctly reflects the Economic Survey 2025–26 assessment of gig and platform workers?
o: 1.43 crore workers, with no projected change in workforce share
120 crore workers, with a 55 per cent decline during FY21–FY25
77 lakh workers, constituting 1.27 per cent of the workforce by 2029–30
120 lakh workers, with a 55 per cent rise during FY21–FY25 and 6.7 per cent of the workforce by 2029–30
accepted.x: The Economic Survey 2025–26 estimated 120 lakh gig and platform workers, reported a 55 per cent rise from FY21 to FY25, and projected a 6.7 per cent workforce share by 2029–30.
accepted.tq: Keep the estimate, growth rate and projected workforce share together as one data cluster.
accepted.sec: Gig and platform workers - Social Security Code definitions, state laws

accepted.s: Article 23 of the Constitution prohibits:
o: child labour in hazardous industries only
begar and forced labour
untouchability and titles
trafficking in persons and bonded labour only
accepted.x: Article 23 prohibits trafficking in human beings and begar and other similar forms of forced labour; the stated connection here is its ban on begar and forced labour.
accepted.tq: Match the constitutional provision with its core prohibition.
accepted.sec: Bonded labour - 1976 Act, rehabilitation

accepted.s: At the district level, which body is responsible for identifying and releasing bonded labourers under the Bonded Labour System (Abolition) Act, 1976?
o: District Planning Committee
District Legal Services Authority
State Social Security Board
District Vigilance Committee
accepted.x: District-level Vigilance Committees are responsible for identifying and releasing bonded labourers under the 1976 Act.
accepted.tq: Identify the authority assigned the specific enforcement function.
accepted.sec: Bonded labour - 1976 Act, rehabilitation

accepted.s: The Central Sector Scheme for Rehabilitation of Bonded Labourers was introduced in:
accepted.x: The Central Sector Scheme for Rehabilitation of Bonded Labourers was introduced in 2016.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the rehabilitation scheme year from the year of the abolition legislation.
accepted.sec: Bonded labour - 1976 Act, rehabilitation

accepted.s:
Which of the following statements correctly reflects the contemporary concerns associated with labour and migrant-worker protection?
1. The Indian Labour Conference has not been held since 2015.
2. Weaker collective bargaining is identified as a concern.
3. Digital exclusion is identified as a concern.
4. Idle welfare boards are part of the debate.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
o: 1, 2 and 3 only
1, 2 and 4 only
2, 3 and 4 only
accepted.x: All four statements reflect the listed criticisms and debates: the absence of the Indian Labour Conference since 2015, weaker collective bargaining, idle welfare boards and digital exclusion.
accepted.tq: Treat each listed criticism as an independent statement and select the complete combination.
accepted.sec: Universal angles

accepted.s: Which of the following statements about social-protection coverage is correct?
o: It remained at 19 per cent between 2015 and 2025.
It rose from 19 per cent in 2015 to 64.3 per cent in 2025, placing India first after China.
It fell from 64.3 per cent in 2015 to 19 per cent in 2025, placing India second after China.
It rose from 19 per cent in 2015 to 64.3 per cent in 2025, placing India second after China.
accepted.x: Social-protection coverage rose from 19 per cent in 2015 to 64.3 per cent in 2025, and India was ranked second after China.
accepted.tq: Check both the direction of change and the rank in the comparison.
accepted.sec: Universal angles

accepted.s: Which of the following statements is correct regarding the current relevance of e-Shram and gig-worker registration?
o: e-Shram completed five years in 2026, while most gig workers were still outside the portal.
e-Shram completed ten years in 2026, and all gig workers were registered.
e-Shram completed five years in 2021, and most gig workers were already covered.
e-Shram was launched in 2026, while gig workers were excluded by law.
accepted.x: The current discussion notes five years of e-Shram in 2026 and observes that most gig workers were still off the portal.
accepted.tq: Combine the date-based milestone with the accompanying current-status finding.
accepted.sec: Universal angles
